title: Seeing traces locally, and the Axiom sink
summary: architect telemetry view|stop|trace|open and prove --view: grafana/otel-lgtm pinned by digest with anonymous Grafana, fed by a second Collector exporter while it runs; a Collector whose owner process is gone is removed at the next start; prove exports journey.<name> as each trace's root; a refusal ends its span ok and a defect ends it as an error; a TraceSource seam with a FileSource; the Sink seam (Telemetry.sink.local() and .axiom({ group }) as a list per environment) and an Axiom sink that exports from the Worker to the EU edge with Authorization and X-Axiom-Dataset per signal, every value read by name from the keychain or AXIOM_TOKEN/AXIOM_DOMAIN, skipped with one line when absent, deployment.environment on every span. User and organization identifiers never leave the machine.
proves: After telemetry view and a prove of acme, the viewer's Tempo answers the allowance.grant trace with its journey root, its step span and its log by trace id; stop leaves no container and no open port; plain prove starts no viewer; a collector left by a dead process is gone after the next start. A refusal's span ends ok and a defect's ends as an error. A second sink is one line of config and a stand-in for Axiom receives the spans and logs with the token and dataset while no file of the run holds the token. The live send to capxul-test arrived with its step spans and no secret-looking or personal attribute.

captions.01-fails-first: The conventions' tests before the change: two fail, the defect test already passed.
captions.03-prove-view: acme's prove with --view: every eval passes and the viewer's address is printed.
captions.04-telemetry-trace: architect telemetry trace for the allowance.grant trace: journey root, POST, the operation with its move, the step span.
captions.05-axiom-live: The live check against capxul-test: the spans and the attribute keys Axiom holds for the trace.
